findings.evidenceJa: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる旋風
findings.governingReading: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる says the whirlwind turns anything it touches into a mass of meat in an instant.
findings.explanation: The -05 branch abstracts the source’s image of being turned into a lump of flesh.

findings.highlight: a battle that is nearly impossible for humans
findings.evidenceJa: 人の身では到底及ばない戦い
findings.governingReading: 人の身では到底及ばない means humans cannot possibly reach or equal this level of combat.
findings.explanation: The -05 branch softens a battle beyond human reach into one that is only “nearly impossible” for humans.

findings.highlight: Even if he aims perfectly, it won't do any damage
findings.evidenceJa: 直撃したところでバーサーカーには傷一つ負わせられない
findings.governingReading: 直撃したところで means even if the arrow directly strikes Berserker, it cannot inflict a single wound.
findings.explanation: The -05 branch changes a direct hit on Berserker into Archer aiming perfectly.
